name: Non-linear Diophantine Obfuscation
description: I replaced the direct product condition (which models easily recognize as requiring unequal values from {1,2}) with a non-linear multivariate polynomial condition (p_u^2 + p_v^2 + p_u*p_v = 7). Over the restricted domain {1,2}, this polynomial evaluates to 7 if and only if p_u != p_v. By hiding the bipartiteness requirement behind a custom algebraic equation, models that rely on pattern matching graph terminology or simple binary constraints will fail to recognize the underlying 2-coloring structure, while a model that systematically evaluates the domain will still deduce the truth.
